nikah.the_office_will_confirm: The office will confirm the time when it replies.
member.name_too_short: Please type the name as the masjid holds it — at least three letters.
member.cannot_reach: The masjid could not be reached just now. Please try again in a moment, or ring the office on {office}.
member.need_both: Both boxes, please — the house number and the postcode.
member.too_busy: Too many lookups are being tried just now. Please wait a few minutes and try again — nothing is wrong with your details.
member.no_match: We cannot match that. Please speak to the office and they will sort it out — {office}, 5pm to 7pm.
member.card_not_on: Paying by card is not switched on yet. The ways to pay at the masjid are below, and the office can take it over the counter.
member.checkout_failed: That did not open. Please try again, or pay at the office — {office}.
member.name_as_held: As the masjid holds it. We will tell you how many records match — never whose.
member.not_on_register_p: The register may hold it differently, or the fee may be under another name in the household. The office can look it up — {office}, 5pm to 7pm.
member.found_one: We have found 1 record with that name.
member.found_many: We have found {n} records with that name.
member.never_shows: We never show a name or an address on this screen — only how many records match.
member.just_number_postcode: Just the number and the postcode — the same two things you would say at the counter.
member.same_answer: If we cannot match it, the answer never says which part was wrong. Saying so would let somebody guess their way through a name they do not own.
member.collected_in_ramadan: Collected in Ramadan, as it always has been. The year is named by the calendar year it covers.
member.at_the_masjid_v: Cash or card at the office during Ramadan.
member.by_transfer_v: Ask the office for the details and quote your reference.
member.charity_line: Bolton Central Islamic Society · Registered charity 1041569
member.next_year_p: The masjid will write to you when Ramadan begins.
member.fee_changed: The fee was {before} until {from}. Each year is charged at the rate that applied then.
member.card_methods: · card, Apple Pay or Google Pay
member.asks_not_demands: The masjid asks for these years; it does not demand them.
member.asks_not_demands_p: Pay this year alone if that is what you can do — or speak to the office, and a year can be set aside or corrected. {office}, 5pm to 7pm.
member.receipt_sent: A receipt has been emailed to you
member.receipt_sent_p: It goes to the address you gave at the checkout. Keep it — it is the masjid's record as well as yours.
